name: mneme
description: Mneme — Collective Agent Memory Layer on 0G

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @mneme/api" "npm run dev -w @mneme/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mneme/protocol && npm run build -w @mneme/sdk && npm run build -w @mneme/api && npm run build -w @mneme/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @mneme/protocol && npm run test -w @mneme/sdk && npm run test -w @mneme/api && cd contracts && forge test
